semiconductor_relevance: Medium — MPS Micro Precision Systems AG provides micro machining and ultra-clean micro-assemblies which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MPS Micro Precision Systems AG specializes in the development, manufacturing, and assembly of ultra-clean micro-assemblies and microsystems. Their services are particularly relevant to the semiconductor industry, offering micro machining, parts cleaning, and surface treatment solutions that meet high precision and cleanliness standards.
capabilities: Micro machining services including small hole drilling and milling
Parts cleaning and micro contamination control

regional_presence.Switzerland: Headquartered in Switzerland, focusing on precision manufacturing and assembly.
